requirements.criterion: An isolated install exposes proteomics and python -m entry points; --help/version never require R or data.
Valid examples pass; unknown keys, malformed contrasts and conflicting modes fail with field paths.
A simulated failure cannot become COMPLETED; optional inapplicability has an eligibility reason.
Arguments with spaces are passed literally, nonzero R exit fails the stage, and stdout/stderr/session metadata survive.
An interrupted writer leaves no apparently completed artifact and a second writer cannot corrupt the run.
Doctor lists actual binaries/package/resource versions; missing R/package is NOT_AVAILABLE and exits nonzero when required.
A real minimal R package installs and its executable test entry runs a nonmocked I/O roundtrip; it returns no fabricated analysis.
Existing ten tests remain intact; pytest/testthat invoke real future test locations and missing prerequisites are not recorded as passes.
All recovered pipeline/legacy/audit hashes match and tests fail on a deliberate scratch-copy mutation.
Fresh documented setup provisions only project-local environments, records solved versions and runs baseline plus foundation gates.
Equivalent shuffled wide/long tables yield identical aligned numeric values and masks; duplicate feature-observation pairs fail.
Linear-positive input is transformed once; log2 zero is retained; configured linear zero-as-missing and invalid negative values are distinguished.
Technical injections never inflate biological n; paired and repeated observations retain subject identity; invalid shared IDs fail.
Linear-mean and log-mean produce hand-calculated different results; coverage and specimen counts are preserved.
Opaque row IDs remain unique while repeated accessions/gene mappings remain explicit; contaminant/decoy flags distinguish unknown from false.
Synthetic DIA-NN, MaxQuant, FragPipe protein and Spectronaut protein fixtures exercise declared mapping/version; unsupported peptide grain fails.
The existing parser is wrapped without editing its source; source-sheet contrast and Method A/B naming are mapped by biological meaning.
Matrix, masks, annotations, observation metadata and hashes roundtrip without numerical change; reruns refuse collisions.
Reports include grain, scale, n, missingness, duplicate keys, provenance gaps and errors; no hardcoded biological confirmation.
Exercise ragged files, duplicate IDs, mismatched columns, empty values, Inf, quoted delimiters, unknown encoding and unsupported assay scope.
An already normalized log2 fixture remains unchanged; every optional transform has a new artifact and recorded policy.
Median/reference normalization factors match analytic fixtures; quantile is explicit sensitivity; missing reference coverage is not silently ignored.
Two-plex synthetic bridges align loading offsets; missing bridge blocks bridge mode, while identifiable no-bridge plex-covariate inference is separately supported and confounding fails.

Original observed coverage is computed at biological-unit grain; ordinary available-case all-missing groups are nonestimable while eligible proDA follows native dropout rules with explicit uncertainty.
Observation/group/abundance summaries distinguish observed versus previously imputed values and do not assert MCAR/MNAR from a threshold.
PCA-only fill is isolated; constant/empty/small matrices return valid diagnostic states; variance and feature/sample identities match direct calculations.
Outlier flags never auto-delete observations; a changed exclusion reason/policy creates a new plan and sensitivity lineage.
Deterministic minimum, stochastic Gaussian and KNN have correct names/seeds/masks, remain secondary and never alter the primary matrix.
Independent two-group detection uses exact 2x2 counts and a separate BH family; paired/complex detection requests are marked unsupported.

requirements.capability: QC source data and stage report
requirements.criterion: All plots have exact source tables; QC-only run completes without R modeling or any significant features.
Groups, continuous covariates and interactions generate expected matrices; arbitrary function calls/code strings fail before R evaluation.
Sample order shuffling with metadata alignment preserves coefficients; absent references and missing covariates give explicit errors.
Batch=treatment fixture is detected, with aliased terms; no pseudoinverse silently manufactures an interpretable treatment effect.
Subject-fixed and eligible duplicateCorrelation designs preserve the experimental unit and reject invalid/unidentified blocks.
Known disease/treatment/residual/interaction coefficients match analytic expectations; significance difference is never used as interaction.
Sparse features get engine-specific n/df/reason records; ordinary available-case all-missing groups are nonestimable and eligible native-dropout estimates retain their prior-dependence caveat.
Sparse nonorthogonal weighted designs match direct coefficient-refit SE/P; exact shortcut is restricted to proven eligible designs.
Unsupported proDA/DEqMS block or threshold combinations fail explicitly and no engine is silently substituted.
Plan saves configuration, inclusion masks, matrices, hypotheses, families and hashes before fitting; config changes invalidate the plan.
Unequal n, singletons, missing factor levels, repeated-unit imbalance and reordered IDs have reference-backed expected behavior.
Eligible fixtures match direct lmFit/eBayes calls for effects/SE/df/P; primary input retains NA and declared normalization.
General designs use validated contrast reparametrization/direct covariance; nonorthogonal sparse example matches a separate oracle.
Settings, prior/posterior variance and trend diagnostics are saved; robust eBayes is not mislabeled robust sample regression.
Boundary effects compare to direct TREAT; true threshold-null evidence is distinct from observed effect filtering and zero-null results.
Intervals use correct moderated variance/df, match independent calculations and preserve unbounded/unavailable cases with reason.
Finite-P BH/BY matches analytic and R references; separate endpoints/primary/sensitivity sets do not accidentally pool or omit rows.
F tests have distinct hypotheses/families, complete planned contrasts are exported and no unadjusted post-hoc claims appear.
Every planned feature-contrast row is tested or explicitly excluded/nonestimable; no zero/NA ambiguity or mislabeled q fields.
Whole subjects/technical sets are omitted appropriately; relevant omission counts are correct and influence stays descriptive.
Complete/sparse/paired/blocked fixtures match pinned direct references and no-null/no-discovery result paths pass.
True peptide/PSM count grain and provenance validate; observed-sample count or abundance proxy is rejected as unsupported evidence.
Installed official fit/eBayes/count/spectraCounteBayes sequence reproduces reference count-adjusted statistics.
sca P/statistic/variance fields are kept separate from original limma fields; shuffled count IDs align or fail, never silently reorder.
Unsupported block/precision-weight/threshold-null requests are rejected with explicit contract; eligible sparse exact-contrast use is verified.
proDA accepts qualified unimputed LFQ data and rejects TMT, unknown incompatible imputation and unsupported repeated models.
Zero-null/reduced-model reference calls match native output and retain model-specific uncertainty and dropout diagnostics.
Engine-appropriate intervals/statistics are verified against native/reference calculations; no borrowed limma df or fake TREAT output.
Matched-universe effects/discoveries are displayed as sensitivities, with unmatched universes explained; no hit-count winner changes primary.
Missing package/backend error is visible, required analysis fails, optional applicability is distinguished from installation failure.
Count-dependent variance and LFQ dropout simulations have pinned reference comparisons, unsuitable-input negative cases and recorded diagnostics.
Snapshots identify source/release/species/terms/hash; changed content or missing required files fails before production analysis.
Fetch/build occurs only in a separate explicit preparation action, records exact versions and never auto-fetches during a frozen run.
Stable IDs/species keys align; symbol collisions, retired IDs and missing mappings have explicit records.
Source/target species and mapping evidence/version are retained; projected sets are labeled projected and ambiguous mappings are reported.
Coverage/median/ID representative choice is invariant to sample-label permutation and never chooses minimum P or maximum statistic.
Multi-gene groups are excluded from default mapping with reasons; declared aggregation sensitivity retains its own universe and estimand.
Gene matrix is finite for required design, models are refit consistently and missing-value loss is quantified rather than silently imputed.
Declared overlap-size filters are applied before tests, full/eligible/mapped membership counts are retained and tiny universe is explicit.
Universe equals eligible tested mapped genes and changes predictably under filtering; whole-genome background is never default.
Tests cover one-to-many mapping, duplicated symbols, zero overlap, ortholog projection, offline checksum errors and stable representative selection.
Plan distinguishes competitive, rotation self-contained, preranked and ORA nulls and rejects unsupported method/design combinations.
Finite gene matrix/design/contrast match official CAMERA with estimated correlation; block/correlation arguments cannot be ignored.
Fixed-subject pairing passes its design only; duplicateCorrelation passes block/correlation without duplicate subject encoding; midpFALSE/rotation settings and reference outputs match.
Directional and mixed raw P/statistics/families remain distinct; central adjustment uses correct columns rather than package-native FDR mislabeled global.
Declared native ranks, ties, seeds and eps settings are honored; NES/log2err/warnings/leading edges and nonfinite tests are retained.
Hand-enumerated hypergeometric examples match; all eligible sets enter the family and empty foreground gives a valid explanation.
Collections/contrasts/null types/primary status obey the frozen families; original and central q fields remain distinguishable.
proDA/DEqMS ranks and linear gene-model sensitivity are labeled correctly and never sold as equivalent correlation-adjusted primary-engine inference.
Overlap relationships preserve original set IDs/P values and do not merge independent discoveries or invent causal mechanisms.
Exact ORA, reference CAMERA/ROAST/fgsea, missing snapshots, NA/Inf matrix, all nonfinite tests and no discoveries exercise honest statuses.
d, t, r and interaction estimates align to planned contrasts with covariance; r=d+t matches analytic fixtures.
Current-data selected features can be displayed but produce no confirmatory score P or rescue label; selection provenance is explicit.
Configured epsilon classes handle zero/small d, RI=1, RI>1+epsilon and RI=3; old unlimited full-reversal label is absent.
Supported joint-covariance method handles unstable/unbounded RI intervals; dividing CI endpoints is rejected and descriptive-only mode is explicit.
Analytic TOST examples match both one-sided tests/max-P and 90% equivalence intervals; a nonsignificant zero-null test alone cannot pass.
Only independently defined direction and valid model-supported conjunction yield adjusted restoration endpoints; FDR-list intersection is not labeled rescue FDR.
Training identity/weights/transforms are frozen and checked; validation-outcome-derived selection or refitting produces descriptive-only eligibility.
All 70 four-versus-four allocations use k/N; Monte Carlo +1 and interval are distinct; paired/restricted permutations honor blocks and ties.
Report distinguishes movement, overshoot, equivalence, conjunction evidence and unknown training overlap; no causal rescue prose is generated.
Shared-untreated null exposes negative effect covariance but cannot yield a spurious inferential score path; exact old examples and RI overshoot regressions pass.
All sections derive from validated artifact statuses/counts and missing inputs never become healthy zero or PASS.
Single run executes the valid DAG, stops failed required stages and assembles a useful partial report with failed stage evidence.
Report opens without external assets/network, has clear navigation and accessible tables, and no paths expose private content in source release.
Observation hierarchy, n, scale, missingness, normalization and exclusion rationale are visible with source-table links.
All planned contrasts/hypotheses appear, including nonsignificant/auxiliary contrasts; estimates, CI, q family and estimability are clear.
Null type, resource universe, leading edges, exploratory status, response caveats and unavailable inference remain explicit.
Vector PDF/SVG and raster PNG as appropriate have exact plotted data, units/n/thresholds and readable labels without unexplained stars.
Methods derive actual config/packages/hypotheses; unknown tissue/batch/provenance restricts language and no canned study claim appears.
No DEPs, no pathways, tiny cohorts, inapplicable methods, failed backend and interrupted stage yield valid honest reports.
A fresh user can validate, plan, run, inspect, verify and compare examples without manually invoking individual R scripts; commands are actually exercised.
Clean Python/R/Bioconductor restore is tested; version pair is compatible and installed package APIs match adapters.
A run with cached snapshots completes without network and semantic output hashes match the documented tolerance.
Code/config/data/resource changes invalidate dependent stages; compatible verified outputs reuse safely and partial artifacts never count as cache.
Independent calls cover every backend/hypothesis/design eligibility; tolerances/versions are frozen before candidate comparison.
Prespecified all-null/mixture scenarios calculate actual error/coverage metrics with Monte Carlo uncertainty; failing methods are not labeled validated.
Known correlated null and spike-in pathways assess method-null-specific error/power; fgsea caveat is retained rather than demanding a false universal guarantee.
Windows/Linux core Python+R jobs execute real examples; expensive release calibration is distinct and not silently skipped as passing CI.
20k x100 medium case logs time/peak memory/hardware, specialized engine cost separately; targets are assessed on actual work.
Plot-data values and references match tables; representative rendered reports/figures are visually inspected with explicit evidence.
Every requirement/test records command, versions, artifact hash, result and limitations; NOT_RUN/SKIPPED is not PASS.
Maintainer locally reconstructs archive values/masks/meta and confirms original source hashes without exposing study data to Packet Implementer, Independent Reviewer or any documentation worker.
Matched-universe legacy mode compares coefficients/BH/declared settings; missing historical environment is explicit NOT_REPRODUCED, not an invented success.
Negr1 auxiliary result, exact permutation discrepancy, different filters/families/pathway nulls and corrected response labels are explained without hardcoding outputs.
Qualified local study runs new pipeline, reports inherited unknown metadata and returns new independent artifacts without modifying originals.
Supported assays/engines/designs/unsupported combinations and exact command examples reflect implemented behavior and actual validation.
Every requirement maps to a reviewed task/test/evidence/commit; unchecked or unverified work remains visible.
Artifact whitelist excludes private data, credentials, environments and execution logs; ownership/license is not invented and resource terms are recorded.
New releases/version folder receives verified source/spec/tests/docs/manifests; original archive package files and private archive hashes are unchanged.
All runnable core/golden/integration/scientific gates rerun on the final reviewed tree, clean setup is demonstrated and residual external limits are explicit.
Maintainer reviews final staged/unstaged/untracked diff, records verified commits and delivery paths; no unsupported completion claim or unauthorized release action occurs.
